# Paper Desk · 论文工作台

A Zotero-shaped paper desk for DeepSeek Harness.
It adds a **Papers** entry to the DSH sidebar, a th

ree-pane PDF reader and a
per-project mind map: the normal DSH sidebar on the left, the document or

canvas
in the middle, and a DeepSeek chat / Markdown notebook on the right.
> 本项目也适合中文用户：界面、AI 精读笔记和共读对话默认使用中文。
## Features

- **Projects with a purpose** — choose **Research** (find a problem, build a
method, compare benchma

rks) or **Learning** (build concept dependencies,
timeline, reading queue and recall exercises). Eac

h project keeps papers,
tags, annotations, chats, notes and a mind map together.
- **Project mind ma

p** — one persistent React Flow canvas per project, with
drag-and-drop paper nodes, Markdown/KaTeX n

odes, edges, backlinks, automatic
tidying and a DeepSeek map assistant. Research and learning projec

ts start
from different templates.
- **Drop PDFs in** — uploads, parses, and files PDFs into a Zoter

o-style folder
(`Author et al. - Year - Title`). Title, authors and year are read from the
PDF metad

ata and first page.
- **Double-click to read** — click the Read button, or double-click any
non-inte

ractive part of a paper row.
- **Zotero-shaped paper rows** — expand a paper to see `paper.pdf`, `no

tes.md`
and any appendix or supplementary files. Extra files are stored verbatim and
never parsed.
-

**PDF reading** — PDF.js viewer with fit-width/zoom, page navigation,
selectable text, four highlig

ht colours, paragraph-anchored notes,
one-click selection translation, and “ask AI” with the selecte

d passage.
- **Math-aware Markdown** — `$...$`, `$$...$$`, `\(...\)` and `\[...\]` render
in notes a

nd chat using KaTeX's HTML layout with embedded KaTeX fonts.
Code spans and currency are left alone.

- **AI deep-read note** — on first open DeepSeek writes a structured Markdown
note: TL;DR, core pro

blem, prior work pros/cons, how this paper fixes the
cons, motivation + key idea + example, how to r

ead the experiments,
strengths, limitations and future work. The note is a normal Markdown file
you

edit in the right pane, with preview, autosave and “AI rewrite”.
- **Co-reading chat** — a dedicated

DeepSeek conversation per paper. It receives
the paper text, generated note, highlights and the quo

ted passage, so
follow-up questions have context. The conversation is persisted.
- **Tags and search

** — Zotero-style tag chips; filter by one or more tags and
search titles, authors, tags and note ex

e tag chips; filter by one or more tags and
search titles, authors, tags and note excerpts.

## Requirements

- DeepSeek Harness **0.2.x** with the Web GUI and a DeepSeek provider.
- A modern Chromium-based Web

renderer (the DSH Desktop app is supported).
- Node.js **22+** for development builds.

Paper Desk uses the active DSH profile's provider/model. It does not ask for a
separate API key. Whe

n provider/model are not configured explicitly it selects
the first DeepSeek Flash/Chat route availa

e not configured explicitly it selects
the first DeepSeek Flash/Chat route available in the profile.

In DSH, open **Settings → Plugins**, install the bundle from GitHub
(`fexas/dsh-paper-desk`), and en

able it. Restart DSH if the host asks for a
restart after installing a new package.

## Data location
The default data directory depends on how the plugin is installed:
| Install | Default `projects/` location |

| Linked local checkout | `<plugin-root>/projects/` |
| Managed plugin (under `node_modules`) | `$DS
H_HOME/paper-desk/projects/` (usually `~/.dsh/paper-desk/projects/`) |
Override it in the plugin row:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The data directory contains `project.json` plus one folder per paper. Deleting
a project or paper mo

ves it to `projects/.trash/` rather than destroying it.
PDFs, text, notes, annotations and chat hist

ory are local files; nothing is
sent anywhere except the model requests made by DeepSeek.
## How it works
[代码示例省略，未执行]

- `client.js` is a single browser module built from `client/` with esbuild.
PDF.js, KaTeX fonts and

React Flow CSS are bundled, so no CDN or extra asset
route is needed.
- The host exposes a small `pa

perDesk` Remote namespace. The browser never gets
direct filesystem access.
- Every paper is a direc

tory with human-readable JSON/Markdown files; the UI can
be removed without losing the research libr

with human-readable JSON/Markdown files; the UI can
be removed without losing the research library.
## Project mind map

Every project has a single `mindmap.json`. Open it from the **项目脑图** banner or
the header button in

ect has a single `mindmap.json`. Open it from the **项目脑图** banner or
the header button in a project.
### Templates

- **Research** starts with:
- Motivating example / problem to solve
- Our methods: framework, motiva

tion / key idea, and why it is superior
- How to evaluate performance: datasets/benchmarks, metrics,

baselines/ablations
- **Learning** starts with:
- Foundations and prerequisites
- Core concepts, ex

amples and misconceptions
- Development timeline
- Paper queue
- Recall and exercises

Templates are just seeded nodes. Every title, Markdown body and edge is editable,
and **整理布局** runs
a dagre layout for the current graph.
### Map chat
The right pane switches between **对话** and **节点**:

## Known limitations

- No OCR: image-only PDFs will not have selectable text or AI full-text context.
- The AI note is ge

nerated from extracted PDF text; complex multi-column or
scanned layouts may lose structure.
- The c

o-reading chat is a focused paper assistant, not a general-purpose DSH
agent with tool access.
- Dat
a is local to one machine; there is no sync or multi-user layer.
